sources.snippet: Welcome to Smol Models, a family of efficient and lightweight AI models from Hugging Face. Our mission is to create fully open powerful yet compact models, for text and vision, that can run effectively on-device while maintaining strong performance.

sources.title: SmolVLM 2 - Axolotl
sources.snippet: SmolVLM 2 SmolVLM2 are a family of lightweight, open-source multimodal models from HuggingFace designed to analyze and understand video, image, and text content. These models are built for efficiency, making them well-suited for on-device applications where computational resources are limited.
